selection_basis: Select the first public ID with aggregate-only governed geography.
permitted_diagnostic: Aggregate-only mapping state; not geographic absence.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID governed with approximate temporal precision.
permitted_diagnostic: Approximate-precision state only; not a scalar confidence score.

selection_basis: Choose the first maximum-count medium-theme cell, then its first public ID.
permitted_diagnostic: Observed cell frequency and support only; common does not imply representative.

selection_basis: Choose the largest exact medium-theme context group spanning sources, then its first sorted cross-source public-ID pair.
permitted_diagnostic: Cross-source governed-context co-occurrence only; not source independence or relation.

selection_basis: Choose the first maximum-count source, then its first public ID.
permitted_diagnostic: Observed source concentration only; not representativeness.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID at the maximum inclusive governed range span.
permitted_diagnostic: Recorded temporal-span extremum only; not production duration.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID among objects at the maximum unique curated-membership count.
permitted_diagnostic: Curated membership-count extremum only; not importance or canonicality.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID among objects at the minimum positive curated-membership count.
permitted_diagnostic: Curated membership-count extremum only; not historical absence.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID with explicit unknown or qualified-unknown creator attribution.
permitted_diagnostic: Attribution uncertainty class only; not creator absence from history.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID at the maximum published movement-context cardinality, requiring at least two.
permitted_diagnostic: Multi-movement-context assignment count only; not influence.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID at the maximum governed theme cardinality, requiring at least two.
permitted_diagnostic: Multi-theme assignment count only; not greater importance.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID with more than one governed geography assignment.
permitted_diagnostic: Governed multi-region incidence only; not travel or influence.

selection_basis: Choose the first minimum-positive-count medium-theme cell, then its first public ID.
permitted_diagnostic: Observed cell frequency and support only; rare does not imply important.

selection_basis: Choose the first minimum-positive-count source, then its first public ID.
permitted_diagnostic: Observed source frequency and support only; not source authority.

selection_basis: Select the first public ID with unmapped governed geography.
permitted_diagnostic: Unmapped state only; not evidence that place is unknown or absent.
